caption: The drawing depicts a tropical scene featuring two large palm trees with green fronds, surrounded by an assortment of densely arranged flowers and foliage in shades of red, white, and teal with green leaves. In the right half of the image, there is a prominent bird with a long tail, colored in teal, brown, white, and red, perched among the flowers and foliage. Another, smaller bird is located in the bottom left area; it is similarly colored but less detailed. The background of the drawing is a muted grayish tone, contrasting with the vibrant colors of the flora and fauna. The rectangular main image is centered on a larger, plain cream-colored surface, with no additional objects outside the main illustration.
title: Chintz
